name: persist_wallcorner
notes: kickstart_persist recipe (128-wide, strong opponents, persistent teacher pull) + w_wall 0.02 + w_corner 0.04 together. On the 128-wide anchored nets each term worked alone (wall 8.4%, corner 10.0%) at no cost in points; on the wide net (wide_wallcorner) they were much weaker. Tests the combination on the net where they worked, in the best recipe for RL4/RL5.
